create_insights_report: create an InsightsEngine from a SessionDB and generate a 30-day usage insights report
summarize_session_insights: summarize the generated insights report for terminal display with token counts, costs, and activity patterns
format_gateway_insights: format the insights report for gateway/messaging with a shorter summary of sessions, models, and tools
estimate_model_cost: estimate the USD cost for an LLM session given model name, input/output tokens, and cache token counts
generate_bar_chart: generate a horizontal bar chart string from a list of integer values with configurable max width
